notes.title: Letter From the Developer
notes.content:
Hello! 

Thank you again for all of the support! I am excited to share with you what I've been working on.

Recently I've made quite a bit of progress fixing various bugs that I've been putting off:

1. Weapons: Fixed a problem with reloading (reload animation would play even if the player was out of ammo).

2. Camera View: Fixed a problem with the camera being jerked around when transitioning from different events (i.e. landing with a parachute caused the camera to shake wildly).

3. Traversal: Fixed a problem where the player's ability to climb walls wasn't working.

In addition to these fixes, a ton of progress was made in regard to world building. Specifically, the opening cinematic has been added which lays out the backstory leading up to Sara's adventure and the events of "Edge of the Wild". 

Here's a sneak-peak image from the opening cinematic:
[url=https://www.avalonstudios.org/development-progress][img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/66b93433e70da415147ad691/8af743b4-c473-4ecc-b76f-734e48fb26ab/Dropship_Takeoff.png?format=2500w[/img][/url]


 Thank you again for joining me on this journey and I look forward to sharing more content as it becomes available.

-Ron Mc.
